## Materials for today

- *Foreign Direct Investment and Ireland's Tiger Economy (A)* © (course pack)

**Overview.** Ireland was long a poor country with little indigenous industry, yet it became one of the wealthiest economies in the EU (by GDP per capita, PPP) — a transformation many attribute to government policy designed to attract FDI. This case traces Ireland's investment-promotion history and the domestic debate over the benefits and costs of FDI-led growth. Because it evaluates a historical record rather than a single decision, focus on **the arguments for why FDI helps or harms an economy, and the evidence in the case that supports each.**

## In class

Working in your team, you'll apply the course's **assess → diagnose → propose** framework to this case and produce one written response per team. The specific discussion questions are distributed at the start of class.
